challenge.prompt: Create a single self-contained HTML file with a canvas-based Snake game. The snake starts at the center, moving right. Food appears randomly. The game ends on collision with walls or self. Display the current score at the top center. Controls: Arrow keys for direction, Space to restart after game over. The game must start automatically. No external resources or CDNs. Use vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas. Ensure smooth 60fps animation.
